# Land to Yield

> Land to Yield provides preliminary screening of development potential for parcels within the City of Los Angeles. It organizes parcel facts, planning sources, possible housing-program pathways, assumptions, economics, and unresolved verification steps for developers, land use attorneys, brokers, and lenders.

## Canonical public pages

- [Home](https://landtoyield.com/): Product overview and parcel-analysis entry point.
- [How It Works](https://landtoyield.com/how-it-works/): The shared parcel record for developers, land use attorneys, brokers, and lenders, and its product boundaries.
- [SB 79 Portal](https://landtoyield.com/sb79.html): APN status lookup under SB 79 and Los Angeles Ordinances 188967 and 188968.
- [Data Sources and Methodology](https://landtoyield.com/about-methodology/): Coverage, evidence hierarchy, official sources, limitations, and corrections.
- [Los Angeles Development Guides](https://landtoyield.com/guides/): Source-backed educational content.
- [How to Evaluate an LA Development Parcel](https://landtoyield.com/guides/evaluate-la-development-parcel/): Seven-step preliminary diligence workflow.

## Product boundary

Land to Yield is a preliminary screening and decision-support product. It does not provide legal advice, a zoning determination, an architectural test fit, a survey, title analysis, an appraisal, environmental review, tax advice, or a commitment to lend. Parcel-specific conclusions require current official evidence and qualified professional verification.

## Coverage

The current core parcel workflow focuses on the City of Los Angeles. Do not infer full LA County coverage from the availability of countywide public sources.

## Preferred official sources

- City of Los Angeles ZIMAS: https://zimas.lacity.org/
- Los Angeles City Planning Zoning Search: https://planning.lacity.gov/zoning/zoning-search
- Los Angeles City Planning Open Data: https://planning.lacity.gov/resources/open-data
- Los Angeles County Assessor Property Search: https://assessor.lacounty.gov/homeowners/property-search
- Los Angeles City Planning SB 79: https://planning.lacity.gov/resources/senate-bill-sb-79
